purpose: This table provides cleaned, hourly weather observations (temperature, humidity, wind, pressure, precipitation, visibility) for NYC-area airports (EWR, JFK, LGA) during 2013, intended to support joins against flight-event tables keyed on origin and time.
usage: Consumers should treat (origin, time_hour) as the row grain and expect wind_gust to be null in roughly three-quarters of rows and pressure, wind_dir, and wind_speed to carry occasional nulls; filter or handle these nulls deliberately rather than assuming complete coverage, and join on time_hour as a TIMESTAMP after the VARCHAR-to-TIMESTAMP cast.
limitations: The cleanup could not resolve the high sparsity of wind_gust (null_rate 0.745505) or the moderate sparsity of pressure (null_rate 0.114953); these columns are retained nullable rather than imputed. No duplicate rows were found (duplicate_row_rate 0.0) so no deduplication logic was applied, and the single-year, three-station scope (year distinct_count 1, origin distinct_count 3) limits generalization beyond 2013 NYC-area airports.
